headline: Northern Sectors Flare with Fresh Captures as Dead Lands Quiets
war_summary: Combat conditions have shifted rapidly along the front over the past three hours, led by a sudden collapse in fighting across the Dead Lands where casualty rates have plummeted to near stillness. Callahan's Passage maintains heavy attrition with over a thousand bilateral losses in the two-hour window, though pace indicators show a general cooling. Fresh localized offensives have broken out to the north and east: Mooring County recorded sharp casualty acceleration following the Colonial capture of The Wind Hills, while an island skirmish in Godcrofts concluded with the seizure of Argosa. Weathered Expanse remains one of the war's most volatile sectors, logging three base exchanges in the last two hours amidst mounting losses. Meanwhile, fighting along the Nevish Line continues at high volume with climbing Warden casualties, even as direct base swaps paused. Stonecradle also registers elevated combat following earlier fighting at The Reach, whereas Linn of Mercy, Marban Hollow, and the southern logistics lines have settled into lower operational tempos.
